primary.description: Make this the primary route, used in notes and the chart context. Only 1 route can be primary.

required.description: Fail rendering if this route is disabled, unless an ingress is enabled.

expandObjectName.description: Prefix the name of the route with the name of the release and chart.

gateway.description: Name of a gateway outside of this chart. Replaces `parentRefs`. Cannot be used with a `targetSelector` string.

gatewayNamespace.description: Namespace of `gateway`. Defaults to the namespace of the route.

targetSelector.description: A string selects a gateway in this chart and replaces `parentRefs`. A map of `service: port` selects the default backend, same as an ingress.

namespace.description: Namespace of the parent. Defaults to the namespace of the route.

sectionName.description: Attach to a single listener of the gateway. With `targetSelector` it must be a listener of that gateway.

targetSelector.description: Name of a gateway in this chart. Takes the place of `name` and `namespace`.

port.description: Attach to the listeners of the gateway on this port.

hostnames.description: Host addresses, supports Helm `tpl`. Required for `TLSRoute`, not supported by `TCPRoute` and `UDPRoute`.

tls.description: TLS for this route. Creates a ListenerSet on the selected gateway and attaches the route to it. Needs `gateway` or a `targetSelector` string. Only for `HTTPRoute` and `GRPCRoute`. Ignored when `integrations.certManager` is enabled.

hosts.description: Hostnames of this certificate. Supports Helm `tpl`.

secretName.description: Existing secret to use. Supports Helm `tpl`. Exactly one of `secretName`, `certificateIssuer` and `clusterCertificate`.

certificateIssuer.description: ClusterIssuer to create a Certificate with.

clusterCertificate.description: Name of a cluster certificate to use.

listenerPort.description: Port of the listeners created for `tls` and `integrations.certManager`. Defaults to `global.fallbackDefaults.routeListenerPort`.

integrations.description: Integrations of this route. `certManager`, `envoy`, `homepage` and `traefik` are supported, any other fails rendering.

certManager.description: Issue a certificate per hostname, same as an ingress. Sets the annotations on the created ListenerSet. Needs cert-manager 1.20 or newer, with ListenerSet support enabled.

homepage.description: Add the annotations for Homepage service discovery, same as an ingress. Only for `HTTPRoute`. Needs `gateway: true` in the `kubernetes.yaml` of Homepage.

traefik.description: Traefik `Middleware` objects attached to the route as `ExtensionRef` filters. Only for `HTTPRoute` and `GRPCRoute`. Needs the kubernetesCRD provider of Traefik enabled.

ipWhitelist.description: Allowed source IPs, everything else is rejected.

ipStrategy.description: How Traefik determines the source IP.

internalHost.description: Internal domain name and port of the auth provider, excluding http(s).

responseHeaders.description: Override the default response headers passed on to the app.

themePark.description: Theme park plugin, needs the plugin installed in Traefik. Only for `HTTPRoute`.

redirectRegex.description: List of `regex`, `replacement` and `permanent`. Only for `HTTPRoute`. The regex must match the whole path, and each one is its own rule. The replacement can use capture groups.

middlewares.description: Other middlewares from `ingressMiddlewares.traefik`, same as an ingress.

chartMiddlewares.description: Middlewares set by the chart, same as an ingress.

envoy.description: Envoy Gateway policies that target the route. Only for `HTTPRoute` and `GRPCRoute`.

ipWhitelist.description: Allowed source IPs, everything else is rejected.

internalHost.description: `service:port` or `service.namespace.svc.cluster.local:port`. A service in another namespace needs a `ReferenceGrant` in that namespace.

responseHeaders.description: Override the default response headers passed on to the app.

themePark.description: `css` URL added to HTML responses with Lua. Only for `HTTPRoute`.

redirectRegex.description: List of `regex`, `replacement` and `permanent`. Only for `HTTPRoute`. The regex must match the whole path, and each one is its own rule. The replacement must be a fixed target without capture groups.

securityPolicy.description: Other `SecurityPolicy` settings, without a target. Merged with `ipWhitelist` and `auth`.

extensionPolicy.description: `EnvoyExtensionPolicy` settings, without a target. Merged with `themePark`.

name.description: Name of the object, without any expanding. Cannot be used with `targetSelector`.

namespace.description: Namespace of the backend. Defaults to the namespace of the route.

port.description: Port of the backend. Defaults to the primary port of the selected service.

weight.description: Share of the requests for this backend. Set to `0` to stop sending traffic to it. Defaults to `1`.

targetSelector.description: Name of a service in this chart, or a map of `service: port` to select a port by name. Cannot be used with `name`.

filters.description: Filters applied only to this backend. Only for `HTTPRoute` and `GRPCRoute`.

backendRefs.description: Where to send requests. Without this and without `filters`, the rule uses the primary service.

matches.description: Conditions for matching requests. Only for `HTTPRoute` and `GRPCRoute`.

filters.description: Filters applied to requests matching this rule. Only for `HTTPRoute` and `GRPCRoute`. A rule with only filters needs no `backendRefs`, eg a redirect.

sessionPersistence.description: Session persistence, needs the experimental Gateway API channel. Only for `HTTPRoute` and `GRPCRoute`.

rules.description: Routing rules. Without rules everything goes to the primary service. Fields the route kind does not support fail rendering.
